mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, timezone, preferred_volume_unit, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, COALESCE(#{timezone}, 'Asia/Taipei'), COALESCE(#{preferredVolumeUnit}, 'ml'), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, NOW()), #{deletedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, timezone, preferred_volume_unit, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, email, timezone, preferred_volume_unit, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
